findings.evidence: The theorem's binders include `(hinj : InjOn f P)`, `(hQP : ∀ x ∈ Q, f x ≠ y → f x ∈ f '' P → x ∈ P)` and `(hkP : ∀ x ∈ Q, f x ≠ y → k (f x) ∈ f '' P)`; the module text at lines 24-28 mentions none of them.
findings.fix: Add those conditions to the summary, or cut it to a one-line pointer to `ContinuousOn.exists_continuousOn_injOn_lift`.
findings.issue: The module-docstring summary says the lift exists whenever f maps into a T₁ space and k is continuous on f '' Q and the identity near y. It leaves out hkP (k ∘ f maps Q \ f⁻¹(y) into f '' P), hQP, and injectivity of f on P, so it promises more than the lemma delivers.

findings.evidence: Line 11 title; the new theorem `ContinuousOn.exists_continuousOn_injOn_lift` is added at the end of the file.
findings.fix: Retitle to cover both results, e.g. 'Continuous inverses of maps out of compact sets, and lifts through them'.
findings.issue: The title 'Continuity of inverses of maps out of compact sets' no longer describes the file, which now also holds the lift lemma.

findings.evidence: The diff's added lines 50-51 put both references in one parenthesis after 'because `Q` is compact'.
findings.fix: Move the lift-lemma citation next to the claim that g is a continuous injection of Q into U, and leave only `continuousOn_invFunOn_image_of_isCompact` on the compactness claim.
findings.issue: `ContinuousOn.exists_continuousOn_injOn_lift` is cited as support for 'the inverse of f is continuous because Q is compact'. The lift lemma does not prove that; it takes continuity of the inverse as a hypothesis and yields continuity and injectivity of g.

summary: The new lemma's own docstring matches its statement, but the module docstring summary of it leaves out hypotheses the lemma needs, and one citation in InverseSet.lean sits next to the wrong claim.
